sources.title: Deep Research Max preview
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Exact agent ID; 1,048,576-token input context; text, image, PDF, audio and video inputs; text and image outputs; planning, visualization, MCP and File Search. Page dated April 28, 2026. Neither total nor active parameters are stated.

sources.title: Deep Research Max: a step change for autonomous research agents
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. April 21, 2026 announcement makes Deep Research and Max publicly available that day through paid Gemini API tiers. Explicitly says built with Gemini 3.1 Pro and describes Max reasoning, searching and report refinement with additional inference compute. It supplies no numerical parameter specification.

sources.title: Gemini Deep Research agent
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. October 13, 2026 guide explicitly lists this Max agent ID. Access is exclusively through Interactions API. Supports reasoning summaries, remote MCP, search, file search and visualizations; custom Function Calling tools are unsupported. Neither a total nor active parameter count is provided.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Gemini API service terms effective March 23, 2026 impose use restrictions and prohibit extracting underlying models or parameter weights; supports proprietary service classification rather than a documentation-content license.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Model Card
sources.evidence: Fresh full model card checked October 27, 2026. Identifies Gemini 3.1 Pro as based on Gemini 3 Pro and explicitly refers architecture to the Gemini 3 Pro card. No numerical total or active parameter count for the named backbone is disclosed; safety comparisons contain no parameter-size column.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card (updated May 2026)
sources.evidence: Fresh full updated-May-2026 card checked October 27, 2026. Explicitly includes Gemini 3.1 Pro in its family and describes a sparse MoE Transformer activating a subset per token. Neither total nor active counts are given for Gemini 3 Pro or Gemini 3.1 Pro.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card (October 2026)
sources.evidence: Fresh full October-2026 card checked October 27, 2026. Describes Argon as a sparse MoE and compares safety performance against Gemini 3.1 Pro. The comparison measures percentage-point changes, not parameter counts; no retrospective total or active count for Gemini 3.1 Pro or Deep Research Max is supplied.

sources.title: Build with Gemini Deep Research
sources.evidence: December 11, 2025 announcement covers the earlier Deep Research API agent. The April 2026 announcement introduces Max separately, so this earlier date is not this variant's release.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report
sources.evidence: Fresh full report checked October 27, 2026, including Gemini 3.1 Pro comparisons, table headings and all parameter references. The tables report capability and safety results, with no explicit total or activated-parameter column for Gemini 3.1 Pro or this agent.

sources.title: What LLMs Must Forget to Teach Effectively: A DIY Approach to Premodern Japanese Language Pedagogy (v1)
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-base parameter search led to this application paper. Its conclusion asserts more than two trillion parameters for Gemini 3.1 Pro without a supporting citation, measurement or derivation. These authors describe their pedagogical applications rather than the development of Gemini. This is an unsupported secondary claim about model size, not a developer specification or a substantiated estimate.

sources.title: What LLMs Must Forget to Teach Effectively: A DIY Approach to Premodern Japanese Language Pedagogy (v2)
sources.evidence: Checked the later version October 27, 2026. It contains neither the two-trillion parameter assertion from v1 nor any other total or active parameter specification. The earlier assertion therefore supplies no supported count for this audit.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash Model Card
sources.evidence: Fresh full later card checked October 27, 2026. Gemini 3.1 Pro appears in performance comparisons, but the tables report benchmark scores rather than total or activated parameters. No usable retrospective size disclosure for the named backbone.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash Model Card
sources.evidence: Fresh full later card and comparison headings checked October 27, 2026 for missed total or active counts. No numerical parameter disclosure for Deep Research Max or its Gemini 3.1 Pro backbone; specifications or lineage of this separate Flash model are not transferred.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
sources.evidence: Fresh full report checked October 27, 2026. Its Deep Research references concern earlier Gemini 2.5-era use, with no size disclosure for the April 2026 Max agent or Gemini 3.1 Pro. Numerical parameter sizes in cited architecture literature do not specify this model.

name.note: Official name with capitalization normalized to the catalog.

developer.note: Google announcement authored by Google DeepMind product/program managers.

family.note: Catalog family normalization reflects the explicitly documented Gemini 3.1 Pro backbone; this identifier is an agent.

release_date.note: Public preview availability began on April 21, 2026. The December 2025 agent is a predecessor.

open_weights.note: Managed agent available exclusively through the Interactions API, with proprietary service terms and no published weight release.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the governed API service; the page-content and code-sample licenses do not license the model weights.

parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-agent, Deep Research Max and Gemini 3.1 Pro parameter searches, reopened original sources, and later first-party comparisons found no supported total. Google explicitly names Gemini 3.1 Pro as the backbone, so a supported nominal backbone size would be usable with that scope; neither its card nor the referenced Gemini 3 Pro card publishes one. The unrelated application paper's unsupported greater-than-2T assertion is absent from its second version and is not adopted as a specification or estimate. The remaining null reflects missing model specifications, not the presence of search tools or service infrastructure.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh separate searches for Gemini 3.1 Pro active/activated parameters and inspection of original architecture descriptions and later first-party comparison tables found no numerical per-token active count. Sparse MoE is documented, but no active-parameter column or usable expert-count derivation is supplied for the named backbone. Max's extra inference compute describes repeated reasoning/search, not a parameter specification.

architecture.note: No single architecture is specified for the complete agent. Its documented Gemini 3.1 Pro backbone points to a sparse MoE Transformer card, but that does not describe every component of the managed workflow.

context_window.note: Exact Max agent page specifies an input context window of 1,048,576 tokens.

modalities.note: Matches the exact Max agent page; generated images are an agent capability, not evidence that the backbone itself outputs images.

reasoning.note: Max performs iterative reasoning with additional inference compute; agent configuration exposes intermediate reasoning summaries.

tool_call.note: Agent supports built-in tools and remote MCP servers. Custom Function Calling tools are explicitly unsupported, so this boolean denotes agent tool use.

description.value: Managed research agent built with Gemini 3.1 Pro that plans multi-step investigations and produces cited reports with optional visualizations.
description.note: Clarifies that the catalog ID names a managed agent and attributes the underlying model without transferring checkpoint specifications.

Gemini API Additional Terms of Service

patch.notes: Built with Gemini 3.1 Pro; Google has not disclosed total or active parameters for that backbone or this agent. Tool support includes remote MCP, but excludes custom function-calling tools.

summary: October 27 parameter-only re-audit: reopened the exact Max documentation and release, independently inspected Gemini 3.1 Pro/Gemini 3 Pro cards and later Google comparisons, and searched separately for total and active counts. Both remain undisclosed because the explicitly named backbone lacks a supported size specification. A greater-than-2T assertion in an unrelated application paper is uncited and absent from its second version. Corrected the earlier agent-infrastructure rationale and added explicit null patches; other audited field assessments are unchanged.
